description.value: Reservoir-side campground 20 km north of Revelstoke on paved Highway 23, with one of the few sandy beaches in the region, a fishing wharf, playground, and an indoor picnic shelter; gate closes outside the operating season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is the official BC Parks page for Martha Creek Park, confirming an active 46-site provincial campground on the Revelstoke reservoir. The page explicitly mentions an indoor picnic shelter and a 'Book camping' link with reservation policy information, supporting those amenity values. OSM tags (internet_access=no, fee=yes, capacity=46) are broadly consistent with the website; no phone number appeared in the fetched text so phone confirmation is left null.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson' but the park is geographically in the Columbia-Shuswap / Kootenay region near Revelstoke — may affect directory categorization.

OSM email (info@westkootenayparks.com) belongs to the private operator (West Kootenay Park Management Inc.), not BC Parks directly; cyclists contacting this address may get operator-level responses only.
Website content was truncated mid-sentence; several amenities (showers, potable water, food storage, etc.) may exist but could not be confirmed from available text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks provincial campground with 46 sites in a scenic reservoir setting near Revelstoke; a practical and well-established overnight stop for touring cyclists on Highway 23.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM records internet_access=no, consistent with a remote provincial campground. The fetched page did not surface phone or address details in the visible text, so those fields rely solely on OSM tags.
